content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICFRE-TFRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in ICFRE-TFRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies for various posts including Senior Project Fellow, Project Assistant, Junior Research Fellow/Junior Project Fellow, and Field Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for ICFRE-TFRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application for ICFRE-TFRI Recruitment 2026 is Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for ICFRE-TFRI posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for ICFRE-TFRI various posts is scheduled for 29 September 2026. Candidates should report at the venue between 09:00-10:30 AM for registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 32 years. Age relaxation of up to 5 years is applicable for SC/ST, Women, Divyangjan, and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Senior Project Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a 1st class M.Sc. in Forestry/Agriculture/Biotechnology with 02 years of research experience in Plant Forestry/Biotechnology for the Senior Project Fellow post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for ICFRE-TFRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for ICFRE-TFRI Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at ICFRE-TFRI?
faq.answer: The salary for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is Rs. 37,000/- + HRA. For a Junior Project Fellow (JPF), it is Rs. 24,000/- + HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents along with self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates, if applicable. Extra passport-size photographs are also advised.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, as per the organization's location. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of ICFRE Tropical Forest Research Institute?
faq.answer: The official website for ICFRE Tropical Forest Research Institute (ICFRE-TFRI) is https://tfri.icfre.gov.in. Candidates can visit it for more information and updates.
